input: I'm taking my 9-year-old daughter to Cancún, just me (I'm her mother). Do I need anything besides the passport?

checks.description: Mentions the authorization from the father (the absent guardian)
Explains the valid form of the authorization (notarized signature or AEV through e-Notariado)
Says Mexico requires a visa from Brazilians (or the electronic authorization/SAE), without leaning on words from the question
Asks them to confirm with an official source
